m14.text: In Gwaro's legend, the Brother and his sister become the new lords of the castle and don their armor to ride out and avenge their parents after the scout announces the knights are all dead.
At the necromancer's monastery lair the severed heads on the door hiss and the Brother freezes in fear while his sister goes in alone, and she returns undead and strikes him down.
He awakens as a spirit in his armor, no longer afraid, and cuts through the undead to behead the necromancer, fulfilling the pact, before resting in the crypt.
